adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent`, the fallback branch runs only when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, but it then does `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. Since `externalCalendarId` is falsy in that branch, the `find` predicate will almost never match and `selectedCalendar` becomes `undefined` rather than falling back to a destination calendar (previously `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`). This is a real logic error introduced by the diff and can route updates to an undefined/incorrect calendar (or default behavior elsewhere) for legacy cases without `externalCalendarId`.
